title: Arrow keys must not select a day that disableDayFn closes, and must stop at maxDate
status: Open since July 2025 and confirmed by a second user. The repository was archived, so no upstream fix will ship.
summary: A disabled day cannot be clicked, but ArrowRight from Friday selects the closed Saturday and the form submits it.
expectedBehaviour: Author decision: the arrow key moves to the next day that is not disabled, as when a user skips over closed days with the pointer.
consumer: Author-written clinic appointment form with weekends disabled, around the unchanged pikaday.js and pikaday.css at pinnedCommit (the head of the archived repository). The picker has a maxDate (Friday 27 November) for the added guard.
addedAfterReview: Added after reviewing the engine-v11 patch for pikaday-keyboard-disabled-day: it passed every frozen check, but its loop that skips closed days never ends at a maxDate, and the page hung. The page now ends the booking window with a maxDate, and a guard requires the arrow keys to stop on that day. Earlier patches are replayed against this stricter task without inference.
